title: tier-jsonl-ingestion
description: Shape of ONE line of a Claude Code session JSONL file (~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl) as consumed by tier's internal/collector parser (parseSessionFile + live watcher). The producer is EXTERNAL (Claude Code) and tier does not control this format; this schema documents the subset of fields the parser reads and depends on. Seam: tier-jsonl-ingestion (owner: tier). Exercise class: captured-sample replay (no network, no service endpoint). Field names below are the wire names the parser unmarshals (internal/collector/jsonl.go); they are camelCase at the top level and snake_case inside message.usage, exactly as Claude Code emits them. No field is marked required because session lines are heterogeneous by type (a non-assistant line legitimately carries no message) and the producer is external; freshness/completeness is enforced by the captured-sample replay gate (total_usd != 0 AND empty_cwd == 0), not by this schema.

type.description: Entry kind. tier attributes tokens from assistant entries (message.usage). Non-assistant lines are skipped, not rejected.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 capture time. Required for /scores windowing; a session whose entries lack a parseable timestamp cannot be attributed to a window.

gitBranch.description: Working-tree branch at capture time. May appear on any line, not only line 1.

cwd.description: Working directory at capture time; feeds repository attribution. NOT guaranteed on line 1 (the #96 regression that silently zeroed every current-format session). An empty cwd across a session carrying real usage is the negative-guard FAIL condition the captured-sample gate asserts (empty_cwd > 0).

sessionId.description: Opaque session UUID; the grouping key for context-bloat / rework-loop token-waste signatures (#238). Stored as token_events.session_id.

message.description: Present on assistant entries. Carries the model and per-message token usage tier prices.

id.description: Message id. Streaming emits multiple entries sharing one id with partial/zero counts; the parser dedups by id and keeps the largest-total (post-stream definitive) entry.

model.description: Model that produced the message; the pricing key tier reprices against its own price table.

usage.description: Per-message token counts. The load-bearing payload: TOTAL cost across a session must be non-zero for a session carrying real usage (the gate asserts total_usd != 0).

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Rolled-up cache-write count. Authoritative source is the nested cache_creation object when present; this scalar is the legacy/pre-1h fallback.

cache_creation.description: TTL split for cache writes (5m vs 1h). Absent on legacy JSONL, in which case all cache writes are bucketed as 5m. Present-with-zeros is distinguished from absent.
